items.title: Microscope on Mars
items.alt: Pancam image of Opportunity's IDD turret at Meridiani Planum showing the Microscopic Imager lens assembly in the upper center-right alongside the RAT and APXS.
items.usage: Real Sol 9 Pancam photo of the IDD turret carrying the Microscopic Imager (MI). Visually verified: the turret shows the MI optical bore (upper center-right) alongside the RAT (left) and APXS (right), explaining why NASA's webpage alt text named the RAT while the caption named the Microscopic Imager.

research.label: NASA Photojournal: Opportunity

items.verified: Direct visual and source verification complete: turret holds MI, RAT, and APXS together; MI lens assembly is visible in upper center-right.
